correctness.rationale: The asserted graph is Isaacs J5 with 20 vertices and 30 cubic edges. Reconstructed all 112827 nonempty edge matchings with exact f-vector (30,375,2540,10155,24485,34930,27765,10890,1625,32). Independently built the full 677415-arrow oriented Hasse digraph and topologically sorted every vertex, certifying the 30-stage acyclic matching. Its augmented critical ranks are c4=1,c5=25,c6=86; after removing empty pairing there is one critical vertex. Reconstructed the actual signed integral Morse boundaries d5 (1x25) and d6 (25x86); checked d5[0,5]=-1, d5*d6=0, and determinant +1 for the specified 24x24 minor of d6. A primitive d5 cancels the 4/5 pair; the unimodular minor spans ker(d5) primitively and cancels 24 further 5/6 pairs. Since these attaching homotopy groups equal corresponding integer degree groups in dimensions 4 and 5, exactly 62 six-cells attach to the point, proving a wedge of 62 S6, not merely mod-two Betti numbers.
residual_risks: Finite J5 theorem, not any odd J_k or general snark class; no proof edge-uncolorability determines matching-complex topology.

evidence: M. Bayer, M. Jelić Milutinović, J. Vega, General polygonal line tilings and their matching complexes, arXiv:2211.12559, Theorem 13, classifies polygonal line tilings rather than the flower snark, which is not that graph class.

R. Isaacs, Infinite Families of Nontrivial Trivalent Graphs Which Are Not Tait Colorable, American Mathematical Monthly 82 (1975), 221-239, DOI 10.2307/2319844 is about graph uncolourability and construction, not matching-complex CW attachments.

value.rationale: The flower snark is a canonical smallest member of a well-studied non-colorable cubic graph family. The full integral homotopy type of its ordinary matching complex is a natural unknown finite topological invariant, and the primitive 24x24 attaching map is essential information not implied by Euler characteristic or field Betti numbers. This exact benchmark can be used to assess structural graph-to-topology conjectures and compare related 20-vertex cubic graphs. It does not claim an infinite family classification.
residual_risks: Graph-specific exact fact; absence of a general theorem is not represented as a novel general principle.

limitations: J5 alone; no extension to all flower snarks or general non-3-edge-colorable graphs.
